checks.description: Questions must reference an existing topic; topic inference is never automatic.
checks.title: Broken question-topic relationships

checks.description: Approved public questions must include at least one nonblank ordered solution step.
checks.title: Missing solution steps

checks.description: Question identifiers must be globally unique even if a primary-key constraint was disabled or lost.
checks.title: Duplicate question IDs

checks.description: Publication metadata must agree on visibility, approval, trust, reviewer identity, timestamps, and archive state.
checks.title: Invalid publication states

checks.description: Every approved question must have immutable approval history attributed to its recorded reviewer.
checks.title: Approved questions without reviewer history

checks.description: Every lifecycle question must have a valid working pointer and at most one matching published pointer/state.
checks.title: Invalid question lifecycle pointers

checks.description: Generated drafts and unverified generated retrieval chunks must never appear in student-facing views.
checks.title: Generated drafts accidentally student-visible

checks.description: Topic syllabus positions must be nonnegative and unique, including after constraint drift.
checks.title: Topic-order conflicts

checks.description: Tutor sessions must retain exactly one valid identity and a recoverable question reference.
checks.title: Orphaned tutor sessions

checks.description: Every declared public foreign key must remain validated and have enabled PostgreSQL enforcement triggers.
checks.title: Foreign-key enforcement

checks.description: Questions, immutable versions, approval decisions, and approved imports must retain their required user owners.
checks.title: Required ownership relationships

checks.description: Every persisted question-version pointer must resolve to an immutable version of the same question.
checks.title: Immutable question-version references

checks.description: Feedback must retain a matching tutor session, question, immutable version, and reporter ownership fingerprint.
checks.title: Feedback linkage

checks.description: AI reservations must resolve to one session, one student fingerprint per session, and matching dated student accounting.
checks.title: AI reservation/accounting linkage

checks.description: Session creation, attempts, feedback, and AI reservations must not reuse an idempotency key inside the same owner scope.
checks.title: Duplicate idempotency keys

checks.description: Progress, feedback, and AI rows linked to one tutor session must not cross authenticated or anonymous student ownership boundaries.
checks.title: Cross-student ownership anomalies

checks.description: Usage, token, attempt, progress, and reservation counters must be nonnegative and internally consistent.
checks.title: Impossible usage counts

checks.description: Production-shaped data must not contain non-Production ledgers or explicit demo/test/fake/fixture/synthetic markers.
checks.title: Test/demo records in production-shaped data
